messages:
Keisha Brown: Quick coordination thread for onsite candidate Mateo Alvarez on 2026-08-10. He requested: campus access badge, loaner Windows laptop with VS Code & git, vegetarian lunch (no dairy), and a quiet room for a whiteboard interview. Can we confirm items?

Marco Ruiz: I'll take badge + room booking. Which room works for whiteboard + projector?

Keisha Brown: Prefer Room B1 (whiteboard + dimmable lights). Need projector off; candidate prefers high-contrast marker.

Facilities: B1 is available 8/10. We'll clear the room and set chairs in U-shape. Any A/V needs?

Keisha Brown: No projector. Please ensure whiteboard markers (black, fine-tip) and a standing whiteboard if possible. Also low-scent policy noted.

IT Ops: Loaner request noted. /equip request --type loaner-laptop --os windows --image interview-standard --user "Mateo Alvarez" --notes "vscode, git, wifi-cert, no-admin"

PeopleOps Bot: Loaner ticket created: EQUIP-11007. Pickup scheduled 8/9 16:00 at IT locker.

IT Ops: We'll image the laptop with interview-standard and leave it at front desk labeled with ticket ID and temporary login: Mateo_A_temp. Please remind candidate to bring ID for sign-in.

Catering Co.: Vegetarian boxed lunch (dairy-free) available. Any allergies?

Keisha Brown: Candidate is dairy-free and prefers gluten allowed. Please make it dairy-free and nut-free to be safe. Include bottled sparkling water.

Finance: Reimbursement rules reminder: local transit reimbursed up to $40. Please attach the expense form when you send travel confirmations.

Marco Ruiz: Badge will be printed day-of and held at reception. I'll reserve B1 and mark "quiet room" in the calendar. Adding greeter: Marco at 9:15am.

Keisha Brown: Can someone confirm wifi credential method? Mateo asked for minimal setup steps.

IT Ops: We'll provision a guest wifi code and paste instructions into the invite: connect -> open browser -> enter one-time code. I'll also pre-provision a hotspot fallback (mobile token) in case of issues.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: send candidate itinerary + parking map + lunch note 24 hours before the interview.

Marco Ruiz: Also note for interviewers: no camera recording, keep session focused on problem-solving. I'll add that to the panel invite.

Keisha Brown: Thanks all. Final checklist: loaner ready, room B1 booked, badge held at reception, dairy-free boxed lunch, wifi instructions in invite, greeter at 9:15. Ping if anything changes. :::end of thread:::
